steps.title: Resting physiology (15 min)
steps.instructions: Everything for this step happens in the Physio Recorder. Fill in Participant and Session, pick the rest recording below, click 1 Check signals and wait until every channel title is green. Then click 2 Start recording in the Physio Recorder AND press Start here. Press Done when the Physio Recorder says Finished and the Last recording panel shows PASS.
prompts: Hub off the charger and switched on
Belt (port 1) and ECG electrodes (port 2) on the participant
Every channel title is green in the Physio Recorder

steps.title: HRD (heart rate discrimination)
steps.instructions: In the Physio Recorder pick HRD, click 1 Check signals and wait until every channel title is green. Then press Start here: HRD opens. Fill in its dialog with the values below. Recording starts by itself. Press Done when HRD has finished and the Physio Recorder's Last recording panel shows PASS.
prompts: Physio Recorder: HRD picked, every channel title green

steps.title: RRST (breathing resistance)
steps.instructions: In the Physio Recorder pick RRST, click 1 Check signals and wait for green; ask for one or two test breaths through the mouthpiece and check that the Flow trace shows them. Then press Start here: RRST opens. Type the values below when it asks. Recording starts by itself and stops a few seconds after RRST finishes. Press Done when the Last recording panel shows PASS.
